statement: For Elite Series 2, pinned xpad enables MAP_PADDLES but not MAP_PROFILE_BUTTON: it withholds independent paddle key events in non-default or mapped profile states; its ABS_PROFILE setup is reserved for devices with the separate profile mapping flag. Therefore four advertised paddle key capabilities do not imply that four unremapped paddle events are delivered in every onboard profile.

applicability.revision: Xbox Elite Series 2 model 1797, software-side revision at pinned sources
applicability.scope: xpad.c:50-52, 132, 1066-1083, 1161-1208, 1927-1929, 2001-2005. Profile interpretation is host consumer policy, not a complete hardware profile model.
